title: console: the curated page, report and dashboard inspectors show select options in English under zh-CN; their form overlay has no option slot
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV6i8jfWwSXjpWJrjA

Filing gate: ① · Source: fleet (out-of-diff note 1 of the Contract review record 7195508409 on PR #37569, reproduced by the s2-ux-T area thread)

## What happens

The console's curated metadata inspectors for page, report and dashboard render the bundled spec form through `localizeMetadataForm`, over the console's own overlay tables:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts` for page and report;
- `metadata-form-i18n.ts` for dashboard.

Those tables translate field labels but have no slot for option names, so under zh-CN a select's options stay English. `default-period-labels.ts` renames Default Period for zh only, and its header says the overlay "has no slot for option names".

reach: a probe test in app-shell (run by the area thread, not committed) read `getPageForm`, `getReportForm` and `getDashboardForm` under zh-CN:
- page `type` is labelled 类型, with options `List / Interface page`, `Record page`;
- page `interfaceConfig.recordAction` is labelled 记录操作, with options `Drawer (right-side peek)`, `Full page`;
- report and dashboard `dateRange.defaultRange` are labelled 默认时间段, with options `Today`, `Yesterday`, ….

PR #37569 (Fixes #36950) adds a `metadataForms … options` slot to the platform translation packs and the served `/meta/types` forms. The curated panels don't read that path, so these selects stay English after it merges. The platform zh-CN pack already carries these option names: 2 rows for page, 1 for report, 1 for dashboard.

## Expected

- Under zh-CN, the curated page, report and dashboard inspectors show the option names the platform pack carries. The preferred route is to read them from the served or bundled form's `options` slot rather than a third copy in the console tables. If they are copied in, a pin keeps the copy byte-equal to the pack.
- Retire `default-period-labels.ts` (or reduce it to what the slot doesn't cover) and its stale header.
- A pin per form asserting a zh-CN option name for one select.

Blocked-by: #37569 (merge, if the route reads its slot)
Category ①: a user-visible untranslated string with a named place and a reproduction.
Priority: p2 — the grade of #36950. Labels show in the reader's language, the options beside them don't, and no data is affected.
Business reason: Chinese-speaking admins configuring pages, reports and dashboards in Studio see English choices beside Chinese labels, and #36950's fix does not reach these panels.
Reader: seat 2 area s2-ux-T (repo:objectstack#2), after #37569 merges.
Dedupe: searched `metadata-form-zh-cn options` and `default-period-labels` (open issues), 0 matching cards.
Related: #36950, PR #37569.
